problems.label: Add a label.
problems.key: A key is snake_case: lowercase letters, digits and single underscores, starting with a letter.
problems.duplicate: Another Field already uses this key.
problems.duplicateSub: Another sub-Field of this List already uses this key.

list.title: Forms
list.description: One Form per kind of document. Each save keeps the earlier versions.
list.proposalsDeleted: An unsaved proposal is deleted after 7 days, with its PDF.
list.emptyDescription: A Form lists the Fields Vink fills from a kind of document, such as a work order or an invoice.
list.name: Name

new.title: New Form
new.description: One Form per kind of document you receive: a delivery note, a work order, an invoice.
new.fromSampleDescription: Vink reads one example and proposes the Fields. You untick what you don't need and adjust the rest.

sample.failed: The upload didn't work. Try again.
sample.drop: Drop a sample PDF here, or <browse>browse</browse>
sample.limit: One filled-in example, up to 20 pages

editor.createdWithSample: Form created. {filename} is being read as its first Document.
editor.fieldsNeedFixing: {count} {count, plural, one {Field needs} other {Fields need}} fixing
editor.suggestDescription: For a supplier whose documents show more than this Form has. Vink reads the sample and proposes only what the Form can't place yet.
editor.locked: Locked while an Integration is attached
editor.noneSelectedDescription: Add a Field for each piece of data you want from the document: a license plate, a date, an amount.
editor.generalVersioned: Part of the Form Version: Save at the top makes a new version with these.
editor.generalNew: Saved with the Form when you create it.
editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional. Which documents this Form is for.
editor.processSample: Also process this sample as a Document
editor.processSampleOn: {filename} becomes this Form's first Document, from what Vink already read.
editor.processSampleOff: {filename} and what Vink read from it are deleted when you create the Form.

field.subFieldOf: Sub-Field of <parent>{label}</parent>. Every entry of the List has one.
field.label: Label
field.labelDescription: Shown to your team. Any language.
field.keyDescription: The name in the Payload your system receives, in snake_case.
field.keyLocked: Locked while an Integration is attached, so your system keeps receiving it.
field.descriptionPlaceholder: Other words the paper may use, e.g. delivery date, Lieferdatum, date de livraison
field.descriptionHelp: Optional. Synonyms and other languages help Vink find this Field on differently worded documents.
field.requiredList: A Document without at least one entry always needs review before it is sent.
field.requiredSubField: An entry without it always needs review before the Document is sent.
field.requiredField: A Document without it always needs review before it is sent.
field.optionsDescription: The value is what your system receives. The description lists what the paper may say instead: synonyms, abbreviations, other languages.
field.subFieldsDescription: A List holds one entry per item on the document, for example per delivery note line or per invoice line. Each entry has these sub-Fields.
field.subFieldsCount: This List has {count}; select one in the Field list to edit it.

settings.description: Saved on their own, with the button below, and not part of a Form Version. They apply to Extractions that finish after you save them.
settings.reviewThresholdDescription: From 0 to 1. A value whose confidence is below it needs review.
settings.autoSendDescription: Approve and send a Document by itself right after it is read, when nothing on it needs review, Jev has verified it, it fits this Form and nobody has changed it. Applies to Documents read from now on.

intake.description: Each PDF attached to an email sent to this address becomes a Document of this Form. Up to 20 pages per PDF. Vink never replies to the sender. Anyone who knows the address can send to it, so share it only with the people and systems that send you these documents.
intake.adminCanSwitchOn: An Admin can switch on an email address for this Form.
intake.pending: Switched on. The address appears once email in is set up for Vink.
intake.replaceDescription: The current address stops working at once. Give the new one to everyone who sends documents to this Form.

proposal.progressDescription: This takes a minute or two. You can leave this page: the proposal waits for you under Forms.
proposal.title: Proposed Fields
proposal.failedTitle: Vink couldn't propose Fields from this sample
proposal.nothingNewText: {form} already places everything Vink found on this sample.
proposal.onlyNew: Only what {form} can't place yet is listed.
proposal.everything: Everything on the sample is listed.
proposal.explanation: What serves this kind of document is ticked; untick what your system doesn't need. You can still edit every Field next. None is required yet: decide that on purpose, because a required Field blocks Auto-Send.
